title: Launch Week → Quarter: Customer Adoption Canvas
content:
Purpose:
This is a pragmatic, hypothesis-driven 12-week adoption canvas designed for mid-market and enterprise customers launching Redwood inference. Use it as the working artifact for onboarding sequences, experiment tracking, renewal-signal monitoring, and handoffs to account management. The goal is to reach predictable product usage patterns and clear renewal indicators by week 12.

How to use this document:
- Fill out the top-line milestones with customer-specific targets at kickoff.
- Assign one owner per activity (CS, Solutions Eng, Customer Eng, or Customer PM).
- Track experiments and outcomes weekly. If a hypothesis fails two weeks in a row, pivot or escalate.
- Surface renewal signals into Salesforce/Jira ticketing using the linked artifact keys.

Audience:
- Customer Success managers (primary)
- Solutions engineering and onboarding specialists
- Account executives (renewal context)
- Customer product/engineering contacts

High-level success criteria (examples to adapt per account):
- Usage: 10k inference tokens/day OR 1000 embeddings/month by week 12
- Latency: median p50 < 250ms for core route by week 8
- Business impact: two product workflows using Redwood in production (search rerank, chat assist)
- NPS: initial sentiment >= 7 in week 6 survey

Phases & Playbook (owner in parentheses)
1) Launch Week (Day 0–14) — Get to first value quickly (Owner: Solutions Eng + CSM)
  Objectives:
  - Establish access, API keys, and network connectivity (hosted/dedicated/private)
  - Run 1 end‑to‑end smoke test and confirm telemetry ingestion into Console
  - Deliver first example integration (simple request/response or embedding index)

  Key activities (deliverables and owners):
  - Kickoff call (45 min): confirm success criteria, stakeholders, and contact matrix (CSM)
  - Access checklist: API key, firewall rules, VPC peering (if private), KMS config (Eng)
  - Quicktest script: run 5 representative queries, capture p50/p95, token counts (Solutions Eng)
  - Dashboard link: share Console route dashboard and cost-per-token preview (CSM)

  Success signals:
  - Successful smoke test with captured logs
  - Customer can call API without auth/network errors
  - Agreement on 3 pilot prompts or embedding queries for week 3

2) Growth Weeks (Week 3–6) — Iterate and expand usage (Owner: CSM + Customer Eng)
  Objectives:
  - Increase daily/weekly volume; validate model choice and prompts
  - Implement caching/batching strategy for main workflow
  - Run 2 small experiments to test latency/cost tradeoffs

  Activities:
  - Prompt engineering session (pairing call) to lock in top 10 prompts and expected outputs
  - Enable prefix/KV caching on read-heavy workflows and measure delta
  - Implement telemetry-driven alert for error rate and latency regressions
  - Weekly experiment log: hypothesis, config, result, next step

  Success signals:
  - 2x week-over-week growth in pilot route usage for two consecutive weeks OR hitting the agreed usage target
  - Latency and error rate stable within SLOs after caching/batching changes

3) Stabilize & Scale (Week 7–12) — Production readiness and renewal indicators (Owner: CSM + Account Exec)
  Objectives:
  - Harden rollouts and fallback policies (canaries, automatic fallback to smaller model variant)
  - Finalize billing expectation and forecast for renewal discussions
  - Capture product impact metrics (time saved, accuracy improvement, conversions)

  Activities:
  - Canary/AB rollout plan for model upgrades (Release Eng + Platform)
  - Complete security/compliance checklist for Private deployments (Security)
  - Shared QBR packet draft: usage, costs, value metrics, open items (CSM)

  Success signals (renewal-ready criteria):
  - Predictable weekly usage within ±10% of forecast for 3 straight weeks
  - Business KPIs (conversion uplift, reduced handle time) show positive delta on agreed prompts
  - No open P1/P2 operational incidents in last 14 days

Rapid experiments register (example rows):
- Experiment 1: KV cache enabled for search-rerank (hypothesis: reduce cost by 30% at same latency). Result: cost -28%, p95 latency +12ms. Status: adopt with tweaks.
- Experiment 2: Quantized model v1.4 for embeddings (hypothesis: 2x throughput). Result: quality degradation on long-tail prompts. Status: rollback & schedule tuning.

Renewal signal tracker (to populate per account) — signal, threshold, action, owner:
- Sustained usage: >= forecasted tokens for 3 weeks — action: schedule renewal prep (AE)
- Feature adoption: 2 distinct product workflows in prod — action: case study invite (Marketing + CS)
- Cost variance: monthly spend > 110% forecast — action: cost review & optimization (CSM + Optimize team)
- Support health: fewer than 1 P1 in 30 days — action: green status; else escalate to SRE

Handoff checklist (when moving from onboarding to expansion):
- All onboarding tickets closed in JIRA and linked to account record
- Knowledge transfer session scheduled with expansion CSM (45 min)
- Shared QBR packet with exec summary, usage chart, and recommended next steps
- Open roadmap items and blockers documented with owners and ETA

Meeting cadence and templates:
- Week 0: Kickoff (45m) — attendees: exec sponsor, engineering lead, CSM, SE
- Weekly: 30m progress check (CSM, SE) — agenda: blockers, experiments, next steps
- Week 6: Midpoint health review (60m) — present telemetry, value metrics, adoption plan
- Week 12: 60m QBR-style review (CSM, AE, exec) — recommended renewal posture and pricing discussions

Email templates (short snippets to adapt):
- Kickoff invite subject: Redwood launch kickoff — next steps and success criteria
  Body: Hi <Name>, excited to kick off. Agenda: 1) success criteria 2) access checklist 3) pilot prompts. Please share stakeholders and any network constraints before the call.

- 30-day check-in subject: Quick health check — week 4 update
  Body: Hi <Name>, sharing usage snapshot and 2 suggested optimizations from our experiments. Can we sync 30m Thursday?

- 90-day renewal nudge subject: Customer impact summary + suggested next steps
  Body: Hi <Name>, attached is a short packet showing usage, cost trends, and estimated ROI. Recommend renewal discussion and expansion options.

Risk register (top 6 items):
- Network/connectivity delays for private deployment — mitigation: pre-checklist & test window (SE).
- Model quality regression post-quantization — mitigation: gated rollout & eval prompts (Applied ML).
- Unexpected cost overrun from burst traffic — mitigation: cost alerting + burst policy (Optimize team).
- Stakeholder turnover — mitigation: record sessions & re-align success criteria (CSM).
- Telemetry gaps (missing logs) — mitigation: instrument fallback telemetry and run synthetic tests (Observability).
- Security/compliance blockers for on-prem — mitigation: pre-engage Security and legal, prepare attestation docs (Security).

Notes & artifacts to attach to account record:
- Kickoff notes (link to Confluence)
- Smoke-test logs and Console dashboard links
- Experiment register (CSV export)
- QBR packet (PDF) and executive summary

Open questions for pilot planning:
- Which three prompts best represent the long-tail production workload?
- Does the customer require a private key rotation cadence? If yes, what frequency?
- Are there internal rate limits or burst windows we should plan for?

Appendix: Quick checklist (copyable)
- [ ] API keys provisioned and verified
- [ ] Console telemetry visible to customer
- [ ] First 5 smoke queries executed + logs stored
- [ ] Prompt library v0 created and shared
- [ ] 2 experiments scheduled (owner + dates)
- [ ] QBR packet draft ready by week 10

This canvas is intentionally lightweight and experimental — copy into the account folder and tailor targets. Track outcomes week-to-week and surface lessons into the global onboarding playbook for iteration.
